claims.statement: NEPO dev uses port 5440 for PostgreSQL (pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image), 6390 for Redis (redis:7-alpine), 8081 for Adminer, 3090 for the Express backend, and 7173 for the Vite dev server which proxies /api to backend:3090; there is no linter or CI configured — only typecheck and tests serve as quality gates.

Required backend env vars include PORT (3090), DATABASE_URL (postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5440/tingting), REDIS_URL (redis://localhost:6390), JWT_SECRET (must change in prod), JWT_EXPIRES_IN (7d), UPLOAD_DIR (./uploads), NODE_ENV, TRUST_PROXY, CORS_ORIGIN (dev default http://localhost:7173), plus optional OCR/GPS/LLM keys (GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, BACH_KHOA_*, BOT_ENABLE, LLM_PROVIDER/LLM_MODEL).

First-time setup runs make setup which is `infra + generate + migrate + seed` — bringing up db/redis/adminer via docker-compose.dev.yml, building @tingting/shared, generating and applying Drizzle migrations, and seeding sample data; daily dev runs make dev (db+redis+backend+frontend) with make stop / make down / make clean for teardown.

pnpm-workspace.yaml wires the three packages (shared, backend, frontend) and the build order is shared → backend → frontend (backend reads shared from dist/, frontend reads shared from src/ directly).

Database workflow uses pnpm db:generate (drizzle-kit diff schema to SQL file under backend/drizzle/), pnpm db:migrate (apply pending migrations), and pnpm db:studio (Drizzle Studio GUI); production migrations use make prod-migrate which excludes *.revert.sql files (commit 45fbad3).

Backend tests live as many `*.test.ts` files under backend/src/tests/ (e.g. trip-status-machine.test.ts, ledger.service.chiho.test.ts, photo-authz.test.ts) and are run via tsx/vitest through `pnpm test`; frontend tests use vitest with colocated *.test.tsx files; an e2e suite lives under e2e/ as a separate workflow not run by default.
